svg.text: Fig. 2. Autonomous domain-agnostic wake-vortex segregation emergence.
Pairwise separation affinity matrix deduces aircraft aerodynamic wake classes directly from raw separation costs S_ij.
Raw mutual separation S_ij + S_ji (seconds) after spectral ordering
High affinity (dark blue, 144–192 s) minimizes cross-class separation buffer void (216 s).
Spectral permutation discovers wake categories without categorical size labels.
airland13 (N = 500 operations across R = 4 parallel runways)
74.2% of Heavy traffic concentrates on Runway 0; 59.0% Light routes to Runway 3.
Emergent segregation cuts suite wake-buffer loss by 78.4% without fixed runway rules.
